# THUMBNAIL.md — Quiet Wild (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

One animal, one moment. The animal is the subject and is large enough to read on a phone.

## Typography

Optional single species name in a humanist sans, light weight.

## Text

Text optional; the animal's common name only.

## Colour direction

Natural habitat colour. No vignettes that darken the animal.

## Subject emphasis

The animal in its habitat, from the film. Never a stock portrait that is not in the video.

## Composition

Eye contact or profile, space in the direction the animal faces. Habitat visible behind it.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with a species name.

## Avoid

Faces of people. Arrows. Shocked expressions. Baiting or feeding scenes. Cloned competitor framing.
